report.definition_before_count: A changelog bullet is a plugin/skill/hook/MCP breaking or silently-behaviour-changing modification when (1) it sits under a ## X.Y.Z heading, (2) it matches SURFACE_RE, (3) it does not start with Fixed/Fix/Improved/Added, and (4) it matches CHANGE_RE (Breaking change, Removed, Changed, no longer, is now rejected, previously MCP-only, now require, by default, only accept one). This definition is applied before any count is taken. Additive 'Added a new hook event' bullets are out of scope. Unversioned claims are defects, not findings.
